free_tier.stated: Bacalhau-derived pipelines that 'run on your own nodes, where the data is created', positioned for enterprise data control and edge AI inference, with a hosted console at cloud.expanso.io.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: Only with a rented node: the agent could run on a paid VM, which turns a zero-cost edge product into a paid-VM product.

evidence.proved: 'Expanso runs pipelines on your own nodes, where the data is created'; calls to action are a login and a demo booking, with no published plan

notes: Bacalhau, the open-source compute-over-data project this descends from, allowed free job submission to public nodes; that route was not checked and may still exist. A rented small VM plus the open-source agent is the only composition that fits a client with no hardware.
